title: I Took the Cousin Group Chat Through Three Birthdays Before I Dropped the Receipts

parts.text: I paid the cake for cousin Maya's birthday in March and the chat said we would square up later. Later did not arrive. I was thirty, holding a bakery receipt and a thread of heart emojis. April was Jordan's bowling. I paid the deposit because I had a card. The chat said legend. I started a note: date, event, amount, who promised. I did not post it yet. At Maya's thank-you dinner she toasted the family who always shows up with money, looking at me, and I smiled with the note in my pocket.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The toast landed on me while the unpaid cake receipt is still in the note.

social.video_title: March cake, April bowling, a toast for the wallet — Part 1/3
social.description: Heart emojis, deposits, legend. The note stayed private. Would you have toasted back?

parts.text: June was Priya's rooftop. I did not pay. The chat called me distant. I sent a screenshot of the note with two lines filled and a blank for June. They said it was tacky during birthday season. Birthday season is a fiscal quarter now. Jordan Venmo'd a third of bowling and said cake was different because cake is love. I added that quote to the note. The rooftop happened without my card. I brought a store-bought cookie tray that cost what I could gift, not float.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Cake is love is now in the note; June stayed off my card.

social.video_title: I skipped the rooftop tab and brought cookies — Part 2/3
social.description: Tacky screenshot, partial bowling, love as a bakery. Would you have paid June to keep peace?

parts.text: In September I dropped the full note in the chat before anyone asked me to hold a venue. Two cousins paid. One left the chat. The rest invented a new rule: cap per event, receipts in the album. I stayed. I like these people more when they have a cap. Birthdays continue. My card rests. Heart emojis are cheaper than cake and I still send them. The album has PDFs. Love can be a cookie tray. Later finally arrived, just not on their schedule.

social.video_title: The venue hold never reached my card — Part 3/3
social.description: Cap rule, two payments, one exit. Was a toast a tab?
